title: Neon Snake
tagline: Grow the glow. Don't bite yourself.
description: A glowing twist on the arcade classic. Collect energy orbs, grow your serpent and thread the neon grid without hitting the walls or your own tail.
instructions: Steer the serpent with the arrow keys or WASD.
Collect every glowing orb to grow and add points.
Hitting a wall or your own tail ends the run.
The serpent speeds up as your score climbs.

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
tagline: Three in a row, neon style.
description: Classic three-in-a-row on a clean neon board. Face the computer at three difficulty levels or share the device for a local two-player match.
instructions: Take turns claiming squares on the 3×3 board.
Line up three of your marks to win the round.
Choose Easy, Medium or Impossible AI, or play a friend.
Round scores reset when you start a new match.

title: Memory Match
tagline: Flip, match, remember.
description: Reveal pairs of glowing icons and clear the board in as few moves as possible. A calm, focused memory challenge you can finish in one coffee break.
instructions: Flip two cards per turn to look for matching icons.
Matched pairs stay face up; mismatches flip back.
Clear every pair to win, with as few moves as possible.
Try the quicker 6-pair board or the full 8-pair board.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
tagline: Best of five. No excuses.
description: A best-of-five showdown against the house. Read the rhythm, pick your throw and take the match with a clean, animated reveal.
instructions: Pick rock, paper or scissors each round.
Rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock.
The first player to three round wins takes the match.
Ties replay the round without changing the score.

title: Reaction Time Challenge
tagline: Wait for green. Then move.
description: Five rounds. Wait for the signal, tap as fast as you can and find out how quick your reflexes really are. False starts cost you milliseconds.
instructions: Press start, then wait for the panel to turn green.
Click, tap or press Space the moment it turns green.
Clicking early adds a 500 ms penalty to that round.
Five rounds make one run; your best average is saved locally.

title: Rift Breaker
tagline: Break every brick in the rift.
description: Smash a wall of neon bricks with a bouncing energy ball. Move the paddle, protect your three lives and clear the rift before it clears you.
instructions: Move the paddle to keep the ball in play.
Bounce the ball into every brick to clear the rift.
You have three lives — a missed ball costs one.
Clearing all bricks wins the run; higher rows score more.

title: Math Sprint
tagline: Sixty seconds of quick math.
description: A fast, friendly arithmetic sprint. Solve as many questions as you can in sixty seconds, chain correct answers for a streak bonus and beat your best score.
instructions: Pick the correct answer from four options.
Correct answers add time to your streak bonus multiplier.
A wrong answer resets your streak but not the clock.
The run lasts 60 seconds — beat your saved high score.

title: Neon Apex
tagline: Three laps. Three machines. One city.
description: A full 3D arcade racer with three original circuits, three unlockable cars, AI rivals, lap timing and three camera views. Built in WebGL with procedural neon scenery and original vehicle models.
instructions: Choose a circuit, machine and opponent skill level.
Accelerate with W or the up arrow; brake and reverse with S or the down arrow.
Steer with A/D or the arrow keys, and hold Space for the handbrake.
Cross every checkpoint gate and complete three laps before your rivals.
Win races to unlock the second and third circuits and cars.
P pauses, C changes camera and M mutes sound.

title: Rift Striker
tagline: Three-a-side under the floodlights.
description: A 3D football match with original low-poly athletes, ball physics, passing, charged shooting, pressing, goalkeeper AI and three difficulty levels. Play a two-minute match under a custom neon stadium.
instructions: Move with WASD or the arrow keys and hold Shift to sprint.
Hold J to charge a shot, then release to strike at goal.
Press K to pass to the best-placed teammate.
Press Space to press or tackle the ball carrier.
Score more goals than Void XI before the two-minute clock expires.
Q switches your controlled player, C changes camera and P pauses.

title: Neon City Drive
tagline: Checkpoint runs through a living city grid.
description: A compact 3D open-world driving sandbox. Explore a procedural city with roads, intersections, buildings, parks and traffic, chase checkpoint gates against the clock and watch the day-night cycle roll in.
instructions: Pick a mission and vehicle, then follow the glowing gate.
Drive with WASD or the arrow keys and hold Space for the handbrake.
Reach every checkpoint gate before the mission clock runs out.
Traffic brakes for you, but collisions cost momentum and count as crashes.
Staying on the asphalt keeps your top speed; off-road slows the car.
Complete a mission to unlock the next route. P pauses and C changes camera.

title: Neon Harvest
tagline: Grow the grid. Feed the rift.
description: A twenty-day rooftop farming simulation. Plant three original crops, balance water and power, buy solar canopies, recyclers and a market uplink, then sell before the season closes.
instructions: Choose a seed, then plant it in any empty plot.
Water growing crops for two water; crops need water and energy each day.
Harvest when a crop is ready — quality and the market price decide the payout.
Buy solar canopies, water recyclers and market uplinks to scale up.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 650 credits to make a profit.

controls.label: Plant / harvest
controls.keys: Click or tap a plot action

title: Rift Transit
tagline: Move the city. Keep the lines moving.
description: A twenty-day bus network simulation. Assign a limited fleet across three routes, read the rush-hour demand curve, and upgrade capacity before service levels collapse.
instructions: Start the season, then assign reserve buses to routes with the plus buttons.
Each bus carries a fixed number of passengers; unused demand lowers service level.
Watch daily demand and operating costs — every bus costs credits to run.
Buy fleet, marketing and fare upgrades to raise capacity and revenue.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 1200 credits.

title: Grid Supply
tagline: Balance the city. Keep the lights on.
description: A twenty-day power grid simulation. Dispatch solar, wind and gas generation against a moving demand curve, avoid blackout penalties, and expand capacity before the city grows.
instructions: Set each plant's output before the day ends; unused generation still costs credits.
Match supply to the forecast demand to avoid blackout penalties.
Solar and wind are cheap but capped; the gas peaker is flexible and expensive.
Expand plant capacity with the +15 cap buttons when credits allow.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 700 credits.

title: Rift Colony
tagline: Six colonists. One fragile habitat.
description: A twenty-four-day colony management simulation. Assign workers across food, power, ore and research, build habitat rings, keep morale alive, and grow the settlement before the season closes.
instructions: Assign workers to farm, reactor, ore and lab decks with the plus buttons.
Colonists eat one food and draw one power each day; shortages damage morale.
Build habitat rings to raise population capacity, and upgrade decks for more output.
A new colonist joins every third day when morale and supplies are healthy.
Finish the twenty-four-day season with at least 1400 points.

title: Orbit Market
tagline: Buy low. Jump far. Sell high.
description: A twenty-jump trading simulation across four orbital docks. Read shifting prices, spend fuel to jump, fill an eight-slot cargo hold, and finish with more credits than you started.
instructions: Start trading, then buy goods where they are cheap.
Each jump costs two fuel and advances one day; prices change at the next dock.
Sell cargo where the price is high; the hold carries eight units in total.
Refuel at any dock for ten credits when the tank runs low.
Finish the twenty-jump window with at least 800 credits.

title: Neon Diner
tagline: Set the menu. Fill the floor.
description: A twenty-day restaurant simulation. Price three original dishes, hire servers, add tables and protect your reputation when the lunch queue outgrows the floor.
instructions: Set each dish's price with the minus and plus buttons.
Start the service; every day brings a new lunch queue.
Hire servers or add tables when demand exceeds your seats.
Higher prices earn more per cover but reduce demand and reputation.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 900 credits.

title: Skyport
tagline: Every slot counts. Every delay shows.
description: A twenty-day airport operations simulation. Open gates and runways, hire ground crew, and balance capacity against a rising wave of inbound flights.
instructions: Start the tower, then watch the daily inbound flight forecast.
Capacity is the tightest of gates, runways and ground crew.
Expand capacity before the wave outgrows your available slots.
Diverted flights lose revenue and add a penalty.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 1000 credits.

title: Rift Hospital
tagline: Triage the rush. Keep the clinic open.
description: A twenty-day clinic simulation. Balance beds, doctors and nurses against a growing patient queue, treat critical cases first and keep the clinic funded.
instructions: Start the clinic, then watch the daily patient forecast.
Capacity is the tightest of beds, doctors and nurses.
Critical cases are treated first; untreated patients cost reputation.
Expand beds, doctors or nurses before the queue grows too long.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 1000 credits.

title: Park Pulse
tagline: Price the day. Keep the queues moving.
description: A twenty-day theme-park simulation. Set the ticket price, build rides, hire attendants and run campaigns while balancing demand against queue capacity.
instructions: Set the day ticket with the minus and plus buttons.
Open the park; demand responds to price, reputation and marketing.
Build rides or hire attendants when queues exceed capacity.
Guests spend extra credits on food and games.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 5000 credits.

title: Factory Line
tagline: Keep the line fed. Ship every order.
description: A twenty-day production simulation. Balance machines, operators and automation against a growing order book, and keep the backlog from eating your margin.
instructions: Start the line and watch the daily order book.
Machines and operators set capacity; automation multiplies output.
Backlogged orders lose credits, so upgrade before demand rises.
Balance machine costs against the revenue from shipped units.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 1500 credits.

title: Cargo Ring
tagline: Fill the contracts. Keep the fleet rolling.
description: A twenty-day freight simulation. Assign trucks across three contract lanes, buy depot capacity, and sign bigger contracts while fuel costs eat into every crate.
instructions: Assign reserve trucks to the inner, outer and deep contract lanes.
Each truck carries twelve crates; demand shifts every day.
Buy trucks, sign bigger contracts and improve fuel efficiency.
Recall trucks from quiet lanes when another lane is short.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 2000 credits.

title: Aqua Grid
tagline: Every drop has to reach the city.
description: A twenty-day water-network simulation. Balance pumps, reservoir storage and aging pipes against city demand, repairing leaks before the shortfall penalty lands.
instructions: Start the grid; each day pumps fill the reservoir and leaks drain it.
Pipes degrade every day, increasing the leak rate.
Install pumps for more inflow or repair pipes to reduce leaks.
Keep the reservoir above demand to avoid shortfall penalties.
Finish the twenty-day season with at least 1200 credits.

title: Signal Stack
tagline: Drop on the line. Keep the signal alive.
description: A timing puzzle about stacking signal bars. Drop the moving bar on the block below; overhang is cut away, perfect drops widen the next bar, and a complete miss ends the run.
instructions: Watch the glowing bar slide across the top.
Press Space or click Drop when it overlaps the block below.
The new block shrinks to the overlap; a perfect drop widens it.
A complete miss ends the run.
Build the tallest signal tower you can.

title: Rift Runner
tagline: Jump the signal. Outrun the dark.
description: An endless neon runner. Jump incoming barriers as the speed climbs, clear obstacles for bonus points, and keep the runner alive for the best local score.
instructions: Press Space, Arrow Up or W to jump.
Clear barriers to add points; distance raises the speed.
Tall barriers arrive every third spawn.
Press P to pause the run.
Survive as long as you can and beat your best score.

title: Rift Tactics
tagline: A small squad. A tight grid.
description: A turn-based tactics battle on a five-by-five grid. Move squad units one square or attack in range; every action gives one hostile a turn, so finish the sector fast.
instructions: Select a squad unit on the grid.
Click an empty adjacent square to move, or a hostile in range to attack.
Every action gives one hostile a turn; hostiles close in and attack.
Clear every hostile to secure the sector.
Win in fewer turns for a higher score.

title: Rift Chess
tagline: Real chess. Five levels. Forty original puzzles.
description: A complete chess board with legal-move validation, castling, en passant, promotion, local clocks, five computer levels and forty original mate puzzles. Play a friend on one device or face the browser opponent; saved computer games and records stay in this browser.
instructions: Select a piece, then a highlighted square. Drag-and-drop also works.
Castling, en passant and promotion follow standard chess rules.
Pick 2 players for a shared board with an optional local clock.
Face the computer at one of five internal strength levels; these labels are not Elo ratings.
Solve forty original mate-in-one and mate-in-two puzzles at your own pace.
Saved computer games resume after a reload in the same browser.

controls.label: Move
controls.keys: Click / tap a highlighted square or drag the piece

controls.label: Keyboard
controls.keys: Arrow keys move focus; Enter or Space selects

title: Neon Rush
tagline: Three lanes. One runner. No finish line.
description: A three-lane endless runner through a procedurally generated neon corridor. Jump barriers, roll under gates and dodge trains while shards build a combo; shield, magnet and overdrive power-ups change each run. Endless and time-attack modes, with bests saved only in this browser.
instructions: Choose Endless or Time Attack, then start the run.
Switch lanes to line up a clear route; trains cannot be jumped or rolled.
Jump barriers and roll under overhead gates.
Collect shards to build a combo multiplier up to 6x.
Shield absorbs one hit, magnet pulls shards from nearby lanes, overdrive speeds you up and phases through obstacles.
Endless ends after two crashes; Time Attack charges two seconds per crash instead.
Best score, distance and shard records stay in this browser.

controls.label: Touch
controls.keys: Swipe the track or use the on-screen buttons

title: Penalty Protocol
tagline: Five kicks. Six corners. One keeper read.
description: A penalty shootout against a keeper who learns your favourite corner. Pick one of six corners to shoot, then dive to the CPU's corner when they step up. Level after five kicks goes to sudden death, with three keeper difficulty levels and browser-local records.
instructions: Choose a keeper difficulty, then start the shootout.
When you shoot, pick one of the six corners of the goal.
When the CPU shoots, pick where your keeper dives.
The keeper reads your most-used corner more often on higher difficulties.
Outscore the CPU over five kicks to win; a tie goes to sudden death.
Kick history, best score, win streak and record stay in this browser.

controls.label: Pointer
controls.keys: Click or tap a goal corner

title: Hoop Circuit
tagline: Sixty seconds. Four spots. One drifting rim.
description: A sixty-second arcade basketball run. Set your arc and power from four spots around the half court, then shoot before the clock runs out. Swishes score three, rim-ins two, and every third make multiplies your streak. Rookie leaves the rim still, Pro drifts it gently and All-Star sweeps it fast.
instructions: Choose a rim difficulty, then tip off.
Aim with the up and down controls and set power with left and right.
Shoot before the sixty-second clock expires; a shot in flight still counts.
Swishes score three, rim-ins two, and a streak of three or more multiplies points.
On Pro and All-Star the rim drifts, so lead the target.
Best score, best streak and shooting totals stay in this browser.

title: Lawn Protocol
tagline: Grow the grid. Hold the line.
description: A five-lane rooftop defence game. Plant eight bio-modules on a 5 by 9 grid, collect light and hold back ten rust-swarm enemy types across twelve authored levels. Every lane has one emergency purge, stars reward a clean defence, and endless mode escalates until the core falls; all progress stays in this browser.
instructions: Pick a level or endless mode, then deploy the defence.
Select a seed card and tap an empty grid cell to plant a module.
Collect light tokens by tapping them; Photoferns also generate light over time.
Each lane has one emergency purge that clears it when a rust unit reaches the core.
Shovel a module for half its cost, or use it to rebuild a lane mid-wave.
Survive all waves to win; earn three stars by retaking no damage and using no purges.
Campaign stars, unlocks and endless bests stay in this browser.

controls.label: Plant
controls.keys: Click or tap an empty cell

controls.label: Touch
controls.keys: Tap a seed card, then tap a cell

title: Apex Time Trial
tagline: One machine. Three circuits. The clock.
description: A solo 3D precision racer with three original circuits, two laps, ordered checkpoints and a bronze-to-author medal ladder. Glass and metal sectors cut grip, respawns cost time, and every personal best saves a ghost you can race against. Records and ghosts stay in this browser.
instructions: Choose a circuit, machine and camera, then start the trial.
The clock starts when you cross the start line, not when the countdown ends.
Take both checkpoints in order on each lap; skipping one invalidates the run.
Leaving the course for more than 1.5 seconds also invalidates the run.
Press R to respawn at the last checkpoint at the cost of a slower time.
Finish two laps to earn a medal from bronze up to the author target.
A faster personal best saves a ghost for that circuit and car pair.
Records, medals and ghosts are stored in this browser only.

title: Street Cricket
tagline: Six balls. One rooftop. Timing over statistics.
description: A 3D rooftop cricket game built around timing, placement and shot choice instead of spreadsheets. Bat through a Super Over, chase a rolled target on a rooftop, or grind a net session; then bowl the same over back with line, length and variation. Six original districts, run records and personal bests stay in this browser.
instructions: Pick a format and a district, then start the match.
Bat: read the line and length, aim your shot, choose block, drive or loft, and swing as the ball arrives.
Timing beats power: perfect contact finds gaps, mistimed contact loops catches.
Bowl: choose line, length and variation, then release; the rooftop fielders do the rest.
Super Over alternates six-ball innings and replays a tie up to three times.
Rooftop Chase hands you a target and a wicket budget; Nets is a pure batting session.
Records and district settings are stored in this browser only.

controls.label: Touch
controls.keys: On-screen aim, shot and bowl controls

title: Neon Craft
tagline: Mine, build and survive a seeded voxel frontier.
description: A first-person voxel sandbox with four biomes, caves, ores, farming, crafting stations and a full day-night cycle. Every world is generated from a seed, every texture is drawn procedurally in the browser, and three IndexedDB save slots keep your builds on this device. Survive Gloomlings and Cinder Wisps, light your base, plant crops and shape the terrain block by block.
instructions: Create a seeded world in one of three save slots, or start an unsaved session.
Click the world to capture the mouse, then look with the mouse and move with WASD.
Hold left click to mine the highlighted block; it drops into your hotbar inventory.
Right click places the selected hotbar block, uses tools, or opens a Workbench and Kiln.
Press E for the inventory to rearrange items and open the crafting panel.
Craft tools and stations from 33 recipes spread across hand, workbench and kiln stations.
Eat food to restore hunger, and plant seeds on watered farmland to grow crops.
Light your base before dusk: hostile creatures spawn in the dark.
The world autosaves on pause, on page hide and every minute; Esc pauses and opens settings.

controls.label: Touch
controls.keys: On-screen stick, look pad and action buttons

title: Rift Rally
tagline: Three laps of drift, boost and gate-to-gate racing.
description: A 3D arcade rally across three original circuits: the coastal sweep of Coastal Ring, the stacked Interchange and the tight neon alleys of Night Market. Pick a grip, balanced or drift machine, choose weather and rival tier, then chase six checkpoint gates a lap across a three-car field. Released drifts charge a boost, a ghost of your best lap races alongside you, and lap records stay in this browser.
instructions: Choose a circuit, a car class and race setup, then start the race.
Hold throttle to build speed; brake into tight corners and steer against the slide.
Hold drift through a corner to charge the boost, then release and accelerate out.
Thread all six checkpoint gates each lap in order; missing one costs you time.
Three laps against three rivals. Weather and rival tier change grip and aggression.
Cycle chase, hood and bumper cameras with C.
Your fastest lap races back as a ghost and is stored in this browser only.

controls.label: Throttle / brake / steer
controls.keys: W S A D or ArrowUp ArrowDown ArrowLeft ArrowRight

controls.label: Touch
controls.keys: On-screen steering, throttle, brake and drift

title: Neon Duel
tagline: Best of three. Four fighters. One rooftop.
description: A 2D arcade fighter on a rain-slick rooftop. Four original fighters with distinct reach, speed and jump arcs trade light, heavy and meter-burning specials across best-of-three sixty-second rounds. Climb a five-rung ladder against seeded rivals that react to your habits, or drill a resetting training dummy. Combos, chip damage, dash cooldowns and air evasion are all fixed at a deterministic 60 Hz tick, so every rematch is decided by timing rather than luck.
instructions: Pick a fighter and a gym mode, then choose Fight for a ladder bout or Start training for the dummy.
Walk with A and D, jump with W, block with S and dash with Shift.
Strike with J for light, K for heavy and L for the special once your meter is half full.
Land a light and cancel into heavy or special to extend a combo.
Rounds last sixty seconds; the fighter with more health when time expires takes the round.
Win two rounds to take the match and advance one rung up the five-fight ladder.
Training keeps resetting the dummy so you can practise combos without a run ending.

controls.label: Jump / block
controls.keys: W or Space / S or ArrowDown

controls.label: Touch
controls.keys: On-screen move, block, jump and attack buttons
